assessment: This study is a detailed, systematic comparison of visually evoked population receptive fields (pRFs) measured non-invasively with MRI and invasively with electrophysiology in the same primate species. The authors show that MRI pRFs provide a good estimate of receptive fields based on multi-unit spiking activity in early visual areas. These results make an important contribution to our understanding of human imaging data in research and in the clinic.
